column1: # repo-credentials.tsv -- THE ONE PLACE a repo is tied to an extra credential
# mounted into its OWN pass container, beside the two every pass gets
# from agent/run-agent.sh (#1656). A second line here, never a second case in
# run-agent.sh itself, is how another repo gets its own token.
# Columns: owner/repo (TAB) credential key under CRED_DIR (/etc/selfdev)
# A row names ONE file, mounted read-only at MOUNT_ROOT/<key> (default
# /run/<key>) inside that repo's own pass container -- never a path a caller
# A row whose file is not yet on this host mounts nothing; that is silent and
# not a REFUSED, since the GH mint is the only credential a pass cannot run
# baudin-octoprint-key, baudin-router-creds and baudin-modem-creds sit beside
# baudin-ha-token on dexter (#1656) but carry no row here: Zach has not said a
# pass may hold them, and the router/modem pair also carries its own
# once-per-run, weeknight-after-18:00-or-weekend rule that nothing here
# enforces. Do not add rows for them on your own judgement.
